title: Organise and review a collection
summary: A collection groups related requests and examples. Review its target URLs, scripts and exported data before sharing or running it.
introduction: A collection groups related requests and examples. Review its target URLs, scripts and exported data before sharing or running it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain organise and review a collection
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A collection groups related requests and examples. Review its target URLs, scripts and exported data before sharing or running it.

blocks.title: Organise and review a collection

blocks.text: The collection documents both a normal result and an error case. Examples remain illustrative until checked against a real authorised service.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a short collection description that states its purpose.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.text: A downloaded collection can contain scripts; inspect it before running.
